name: Vanilla Android -Shikozaru DT Daigakusei no Ore to Bishoujo Android ga Ironna Play de Hame Pako Mission-
original_name: Vanilla Android -シコ猿DT大学生の俺と美少女アンドロイドがいろんなプレイでハメパコミッション！-
source:
Kakizaki Hajime (protagonist's name can be changed), a university student who is running out of savings, finds a part-time job that is obviously suspicious but pays well.

"Men only"
"Looking for men who are sexually confident"

He's a virgin, but he's confident in his stamina! With this logic in mind, he heads to the specified address and arrives at the "True Next Generation Technology Research Institute."

After signing a contract with a woman who calls herself "Doctor", the protagonist comes face to face with the android Minerva lying in the laboratory. She is a next-generation android, who is packed with all kinds of knowledge. Her mission is to become a new companion for humanity.

Hajime's task is to perform various sexual acts on Minerva, who is equipped with functionalities for sexual desire and sexual sensation.

[Translated from the [url=http://monoceros-plus.jp/9th.html#storyjump]official website[/url]]
